philippines.title: PCSO completes historic 100% nationwide PTV rollout
philippines.description:
CITY OF SAN FERNANDO, Pampanga — The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO), in compliance with the directive of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., on Friday completed the historic nationwide distribution of Patient Transport Vehicles (PTVs) to all 82 provinces of the country. The turnover of the final batch of units was held during a ceremony at the Provincial Capitol of Pampanga. philippines.title: Mountaineers' group opposes mining bid at Sibuyan protected park
philippines.description:
CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro— The Mountaineering Federation of the Philippines Inc. (MFPI) has expressed strong opposition to a bid to introduce mining activities within the protected landscape of Mt. Guiting-Guiting Natural Park in Sibuyan Island, Romblon, warning that the project could threaten one of the country’s most important biodiversity hotspots. In a statement, the federation raised alarm over the reported mining activities of Altai Philippines Mining Corporation within the protected area, calling on authorities to immediately investigate its prospective operations there and to strictly enforce environmental and protected area laws. Altai has not responded to the latest protests. But based […]...

energy.title: WTI Explodes Higher as Middle East Shipping Risks Multiply
energy.description: September WTI crude oil futures were trading at $92.31 late Thursday, up $10.54 or 12.89% for the week. The contract posted a weekly low at $79.58 before climbing to a weekly high at $92.31. This was not a normal risk-premium rally. WTI started the week with the Strait of Hormuz already impaired, then gained speed as the market realized Saudi Arabia’s alternate export route through the Red Sea was also under threat. By Thursday, traders were no longer pricing one damaged chokepoint. They were pricing a supply system with fewer ways to move…
